description: Privacy-focused Firefox-based web browser with portable profile persistence
post_install: if ($target) { $policy = @{ policies = @{ DisableAppUpdate = $true; DisableTelemetry = $true; DisableFirefoxStudies = $true; DisablePocket = $true; DisableFirefoxScreenshots = $true; DisableFeedbackCommands = $true; DisableAccounts = $true; Preferences = @{ 'browser.shell.checkDefaultBrowser' = @{ Value = $false; Status = 'locked' }; 'browser.newtabpage.activity-stream.showSponsoredTopSites' = @{ Value = $false; Status = 'locked' }; 'browser.newtabpage.activity-stream.showSponsored' = @{ Value = $false; Status = 'locked' } } } }; $policyDir = Join-Path $target.DirectoryName 'distribution'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $policyDir | Out-Null; $policy | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content (Join-Path $policyDir 'policies.json') -Encoding utf8 }
